test_cases.query: Find the fastest route from Karol Bagh to Gandhi Darshan
test_cases.expected_behavior: Call the route planner with the fastest preference and explain the returned route.

test_cases.query: Find the cheapest route from Stop A to Stop B
test_cases.expected_behavior: Call the route planner with the cheapest preference and explain the returned route and estimated fare if available.

test_cases.query: How long will my journey take?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Ask for the starting point and destination if they are not known; otherwise explain the calculated journey duration.
Ask for the destination or other missing route information, then use the route planner.

test_cases.query: Show the delay for route 534 in the morning
test_cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve the matching sample delay record and identify the data as simulated.

test_cases.query: Is route 534 crowded in the morning?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve the matching crowd-level record and explain that it is sample data.
Save the currently selected route if one exists; otherwise ask which route to save.
Call the saved-routes functionality and display the routes returned.

test_cases.query: Find a route from an unknown stop to Gandhi Darshan
test_cases.expected_behavior: Explain that the source stop could not be matched and ask the user to clarify.

test_cases.query: Is the bus running late right now?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not claim to know the live delay; explain that only sample delay information is available.
